edinetdb_annual_financials.canonical_timestamp_rule: Use the source snapshot observed_at and retain filing docID/URL per fiscal-year row.
edinetdb_annual_financials.revision_pinning_rule: Canonical rows are content-addressed by deterministic SHA-256 over sorted-key compact JSON records.
edinetdb_annual_financials.retry_policy: Collector/network retries are handled upstream; this repository audit never fabricates missing rows.
edinetdb_annual_financials.rate_limit_policy: Do not bypass provider limits or duplicate identical requests.

jr_west_official_ir.primary_source: West Japan Railway Company official IR, press releases, and official FAQ
jr_west_official_ir.canonical_timestamp_rule: Record the date or timezone-aware timestamp when the primary sources were checked.
jr_west_official_ir.revision_pinning_rule: Pin the materialized artifact by SHA-256 and retain every official source URL used.
jr_west_official_ir.retry_policy: Do not promote unavailable fields to observed values.
jr_west_official_ir.rate_limit_policy: Use normal official-site access; do not bypass access controls.
jr_west_official_ir.schema_expectations: Dataset-specific JSON/NDJSON schema declared by each snapshot entry.

external_mcp_snapshot.primary_source: External provider data retrieved through an MCP tool
external_mcp_snapshot.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain the MCP retrieval timestamp separately from the source fiscal or event date.
external_mcp_snapshot.revision_pinning_rule: Materialize the response or normalized records and pin the artifact by SHA-256.
external_mcp_snapshot.retry_policy: Respect provider/MCP limits; never fill missing records from memory.
external_mcp_snapshot.rate_limit_policy: Do not bypass provider limits or split requests solely to evade quotas.
external_mcp_snapshot.schema_expectations: Dataset-specific JSON/NDJSON schema declared by each snapshot entry.

jquants_api_snapshot.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain API retrieval timestamp and each record's disclosed period/date.
jquants_api_snapshot.revision_pinning_rule: Materialize normalized API records and pin the artifact by SHA-256.
jquants_api_snapshot.retry_policy: Respect official API retry and quota behavior; never synthesize unavailable rows.
jquants_api_snapshot.rate_limit_policy: Do not bypass J-Quants API limits.
jquants_api_snapshot.schema_expectations: Dataset-specific JSON/NDJSON schema declared by each snapshot entry.

us_oge_presidential_278t.primary_source: U.S. Office of Government Ethics Presidential OGE Form 278-T disclosures
us_oge_presidential_278t.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain the repository observation timestamp separately from each OGE filing date and transaction date range.
us_oge_presidential_278t.revision_pinning_rule: Pin the normalized filing index and derived counts by SHA-256 and retain every official OGE URL used.
us_oge_presidential_278t.retry_policy: Do not infer unavailable transactions or silently treat partial filing sets as complete.
us_oge_presidential_278t.rate_limit_policy: Use normal OGE public access; do not bypass access controls.

arxiv_api_metadata.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain the UTC API retrieval timestamp and each record's arXiv published/updated timestamps.
arxiv_api_metadata.revision_pinning_rule: Pin the normalized metadata artifact by SHA-256 while retaining arXiv identifiers and updated timestamps.
arxiv_api_metadata.retry_policy: Fail closed on malformed or partial pages and keep at least 3 seconds between legacy API requests.
arxiv_api_metadata.rate_limit_policy: Use one connection and no more than one legacy arXiv API request every three seconds.

public_web_research.primary_source: Official issuer/operator pages plus clearly attributed public reporting used for research evidence
public_web_research.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain the timezone-aware retrieval timestamp separately from each source publication or event date.
public_web_research.revision_pinning_rule: Materialize normalized claims and source boundaries, pin the artifact by SHA-256, and retain every source URL used.
public_web_research.retry_policy: Do not promote reported negotiations or unavailable fields to verified facts; preserve source class and uncertainty.
public_web_research.rate_limit_policy: Use normal public-site access and do not bypass access controls or provider limits.
public_web_research.schema_expectations: Dataset-specific JSON/NDJSON schema declared by each snapshot entry.

github_domain_repo_snapshot.primary_source: Canonical derived JSON published by a KAFKA2306 domain repository; the domain repository remains the authority.
github_domain_repo_snapshot.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain the UTC retrieval timestamp separately from all source observation, effective, known-at, and publication dates embedded in the domain JSON.
github_domain_repo_snapshot.revision_pinning_rule: Store the exact domain JSON bytes under their SHA-256; do not rewrite domain facts in the mirror layer.
github_domain_repo_snapshot.retry_policy: Fail closed when a required domain JSON is unavailable or malformed; deferred and externally blocked domains are not fetched.
github_domain_repo_snapshot.rate_limit_policy: Do not refetch unchanged accepted content solely to create another snapshot row.
github_domain_repo_snapshot.schema_expectations: The original domain schema is preserved byte-for-byte; investor2 adapters only emit a separate cross-theme projection.

edinet_issuer_master.canonical_timestamp_rule: Use source_retrieved_at only as retrieval time; issuer attributes come directly from the downloaded EDINET code list.
edinet_issuer_master.revision_pinning_rule: Pin the original ZIP bytes by SHA-256 and the sorted normalized issuer set by a second SHA-256.
edinet_issuer_master.retry_policy: Fail closed on download, decoding, required-column, duplicate-code, or missing-industry errors; keep the last valid master.
edinet_issuer_master.rate_limit_policy: Use the fixed EDINET code-list download URL and do not poll more often than the scheduled daily update.

edinet_api_filings.canonical_timestamp_rule: Preserve EDINET submitDateTime and operation time separately from retrieval time.
edinet_api_filings.revision_pinning_rule: Treat docID as the source-side identity; retain parentDocID relationships and SHA-256 for downloaded document bytes.
edinet_api_filings.retry_policy: Do not replace valid state on malformed responses; HTTP/provider 429 requires waiting before retrying.
edinet_api_filings.rate_limit_policy: Do not bypass EDINET API limits or make duplicate requests for already-known docIDs.
edinet_api_filings.schema_expectations: NDJSON records emitted by scripts/fetch_edinet_filings.py plus investor2.edinet-filing-state.v1

gdelt_news_discovery.canonical_timestamp_rule: Retain the GDELT observed timestamp and repository retrieval time separately.
gdelt_news_discovery.revision_pinning_rule: Pin each downloaded GKG ZIP by SHA-256 and normalized discovery events by a second SHA-256.
gdelt_news_discovery.retry_policy: A missing or malformed GKG archive is not replaced with synthetic news; candidate mappings remain candidate.
gdelt_news_discovery.rate_limit_policy: Prefer GDELT raw/bulk files over repeated search-API calls.

alpha_vantage_market_data.canonical_timestamp_rule: Do not treat provider responses as canonical market observations until qualification, symbol rules, coverage, and data-use conditions are verified.
alpha_vantage_market_data.revision_pinning_rule: Store only the verification report; do not publish raw provider responses from this adapter.
alpha_vantage_market_data.retry_policy: Rate-limit, provider-information, unsupported-symbol, and malformed responses are explicit non-success states.
alpha_vantage_market_data.rate_limit_policy: Never create multiple keys or otherwise evade the provider's free-tier or project limits.
alpha_vantage_market_data.disabled_reason: Provider qualification for this repository, Japanese symbol rules/coverage, and redistribution conditions are not yet verified.
